note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. One supplied datum is substituted: the route state on the route's record plate (beforeStatus → the other state). The old value is kept, unchanged, in the dock as 'was'; only the dependent state follows (route drawn solid for 'available', dashed — pending — for 'not checked'; the sheet in the last tray, or waiting in the first with its dashed outline in the last). The bodies are abstract and fictional, of the same size on one row (no rank, level or hierarchy); the route is ONLY the supplied sequence. No admissibility, time limit, leave, ground, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, routes, outcomes, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry and contextLabels are editable (beforeStatus says which state the before value names). OMITTED brief field: grounds — grounds of a challenge would add legal content the inspection of a route's supplied state does not need.
